services.title: Services & Workflow
services.subtitle: A clear process from first call to stable operation.

01.title: Discovery & Scope
01.text: Listen to the problem, analyze business requirements, and lock a clear scope.

02.title: Architecture & Design
02.text: Design the database and API flows; choose technology for the best cost/performance balance.

03.title: Agile Development
03.text: Build in sprints with transparent progress and automated tests. A short demo video every 3 days.

04.title: Deployment & Handover
04.text: Deploy to your server, hand over full documentation, and support stable operation.

05.title: AI-Assisted Engineering
05.text: AI speeds up coding and cuts cost and time, inside a strict process (BMAD, Superpowers, TEA) and MCP tooling, so no AI junk reaches your codebase. Example: an AI-assisted pull-request quality gate (static analysis, security and dependency scans, AI plus human review) cut review time from 30 to 5 minutes.

06.title: Quality, Security & Support
06.text: Automated tests, secure credential handling, and post-handover maintenance and monitoring support.

stack.title: Technical Stack & Experience
stack.statement: I am strongest in Go and React for problems that combine heavy computation with real performance requirements: high-volume data processing, search and analytics, and long-running jobs, built so business logic stays clean and replaceable underneath.
